map.计算最优包邮门槛和凑单建议，提升客单价: Compute the optimal free shipping threshold and top-up suggestions to raise average order value
map.📖 查看「包邮门槛计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Free Shipping Threshold Calculator User Guide"
map.免邮门槛评估：距免邮差额 = max(0, 门槛 − 购物车)；加购至免邮的净收: Free shipping threshold assessment: gap to free shipping = max(0, threshold − cart); net gain from topping up to the threshold = (threshold − cart) × average gross margin − shipping fee, and a positive value means topping up pays off.
map.📚 深度解析：包邮门槛凑单测算: 📚 In-depth: Free Shipping Threshold Top-Up Estimation
map.设满 99 包邮，算当前购物车还差多少达标。: With free shipping above 99, work out how far the current cart is from qualifying.
map.评估「让利凑单」的商家成本是否低于运费。: Assess whether the merchant cost of subsidizing a top-up is below the shipping fee.
map.做凑单提示文案提升客单价。: Write top-up prompt copy to raise average order value.
map.40%、运费 10 元 → 需凑 19 元；商家成本=19×(1−40%)=11: 40% and shipping 10 CNY means 19 CNY more is needed; merchant cost = 19×(1−40%) = 11.4 CNY, above the 10 CNY shipping fee, so assess whether it pays off or adjust the threshold.
map.若毛利率 60%，凑 19 元成本=19×0.4=7.6 元 < 运费 10 元: With a 60% gross margin, topping up 19 CNY costs 19×0.4 = 7.6 CNY, below the 10 CNY shipping fee, so topping up saves the customer the fee and the merchant still profits.
map.用「差额×(1−毛利率)」估商家货成本，与运费比：成本低于运费时鼓励凑单双方都划: Estimate merchant goods cost as gap × (1 − gross margin) and compare it with shipping: when the cost is below the shipping fee, encouraging a top-up pays off for both sides.
map.参考客单价分布，门槛略低于平均客单价最能拉动凑单而不流失。: Look at the distribution of order values; a threshold slightly below the average order value drives the most top-ups without losing sales.
